title: Binary expansion of a configuration code
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on input $x$. The binary expansion of the numerical code of $C$ with space parameter $s$ is exactly the Boolean word encoding that configuration with parameter $s$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
$C$ is a configuration of $N$ on input $x
